title: Wedding Feast
summary: Wedding feasts were public celebrations of marriage and family joy, often involving processions, guests, food, wine, lamps, and social honor.
background: Jesus uses wedding imagery to speak of joy, readiness, invitation, and the kingdom. Understanding the social weight of weddings helps explain both celebration and warning in these passages.
teachingHelp: When teaching wedding parables, keep both sides: joyful invitation and serious readiness.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
